scripts.clean: npm run clean -w forgeframe && npm run clean -w @forgeframe/playground
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.config.json && npm run typecheck -w forgeframe && npm run typecheck -w @forgeframe/playground
scripts.typecheck:package: tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --skipLibCheck false --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 packages/forgeframe/dist/index.d.ts packages/forgeframe/dist/react.d.ts
scripts.release:check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run size && npm run typecheck:package && npm run build:playground && npm audit && npm pack --dry-run -w forgeframe && npm run test:package
scripts.docs:setup: git config merge.wiki.name "wiki merge (auto-resolve generated sections)" && git config merge.wiki.driver "if command -v wiki >/dev/null 2>&1; then wiki _merge %O %A %B %L %P; else git merge-file -L ours -L base -L theirs --marker-size=%L %A %O %B; fi"
